WITH alameda AS (
  SELECT *,
         CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM alameda
  ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
county_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM alameda
)
SELECT 
  t."School Name" AS school_name,
  CASE WHEN t."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter,
  t."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
  t."High Grade" AS high_grade,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.cds IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN s.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR s.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR s.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance,
  t.free_meal_rate - c.avg_rate AS deviation
FROM top_school t
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON t.CDSCode = s.cds
CROSS JOIN county_avg c
SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate FROM frpm WHERE `School Type` LIKE '%Continuation%' AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 ORDER BY 1 ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT schools.School, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.State, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_rate, CAST(strftime('%Y', schools.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) AS open_year, schools.StatusType AS status, satscores.NumTstTakr, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite, (COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrRead,0)+COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrMath,0)+COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrWrite,0)) AS total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrRead,0)+COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrMath,0)+COALESCE(satscores.AvgScrWrite,0)) DESC) AS rank, CASE WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM' WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium FRPM' ELSE 'Low FRPM' END AS frpm_category FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND frpm.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Fresno' ORDER BY frpm_category, rank

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, s.MailStreet AS Mail_Street, s.MailCity AS Mail_City, s.MailState AS Mail_State, s.MailZip AS Mail_Zip, s.Website, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K12, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count_K12, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS Percent_FRPM_K12, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.NumGE1500, CASE WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 70 AND (sat.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM' WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 30 AND (sat.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM' ELSE 'Typical' END AS performance_assessment FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode JOIN satscores sat ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds AND sat.rtype = 'S' WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100 ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT ss.sname AS school_name, ss.dname AS district, ss.cname AS county, ss.AvgScrRead AS reading_score, ss.AvgScrMath AS math_score, ss.AvgScrWrite AS writing_score, (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS total_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_rank, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent, CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 33 THEN 'Low' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 66 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS poverty_level FROM schools sch JOIN satscores ss ON sch.CDSCode = ss.cds JOIN frpm f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE sch.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400 AND ss.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY total_score DESC

SELECT s.sname AS SchoolName, s.dname AS DistrictName, s.cname AS CountyName, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalAvgSAT, s.NumTstTakr AS NumTestTakers, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS PercentEligibleFRPM, CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) DESC) WHEN 1 THEN 'High' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium-High' WHEN 3 THEN 'Medium-Low' WHEN 4 THEN 'Low' END AS PerformanceCategory, CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` ASC) WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' WHEN 3 THEN 'High' WHEN 4 THEN 'Very High' END AS PovertyLevel, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Rank FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE sc.Magnet = 1 AND s.rtype = 'S' AND s.NumTstTakr > 500 ORDER BY TotalAvgSAT DESC;
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE sat.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, frpm.`School Type`, frpm.`District Type`, frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)`, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`, frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumGE1500 FROM frpm JOIN schools s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON frpm.CDSCode = sat.cds ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM satscores JOIN schools ON schools.CDSCode = '0' || satscores.cds WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Street AS street, s.City AS city, s.Zip AS zip, s.State AS state, s.County AS county, s.District AS district, sat.AvgScrRead AS avgscrread, sat.AvgScrMath AS avgscrmath, sat.AvgScrWrite AS avgscrwrite, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS percent_frpm, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, s.Charter AS charter FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE sat.cds = ( SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 10 ORDER BY AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT
    f."County Name" AS county,
    s.sname AS school_name,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll_k12,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enroll_5_17,
    (f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
    CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_status,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score,
    CASE
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS frpm_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f."County Name" ORDER BY (f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") DESC) AS enrollment_rank_in_county,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY CASE
            WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END
        ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) DESC
    ) AS sat_rank_in_frpm_category
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500
  AND (
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 60
        OR (s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3)
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cds, s.sname, s.dname, s.cname,
    s.NumGE1500, s.NumTstTakr,
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS free_meal_count,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment
  FROM satscores s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
  JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
    AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cname ORDER BY free_meal_count * 1.0 / enrollment DESC) AS rn
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT sname, cname,
  free_meal_count * 1.0 / enrollment AS free_meal_elig_rate,
  NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr AS sat_excellence_rate,
  free_meal_count, enrollment
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY free_meal_elig_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname AS School, sc.Phone, sc.City, sc.Charter, CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty' ELSE 'Very Low Poverty' END AS Poverty_Classification, CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL)/s.NumTstTakr AS SAT_Excellence_Rate FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode LEFT JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.NumTstTakr > 0 ORDER BY SAT_Excellence_Rate DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.NCESSchool FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT dname FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.rtype = 'D' AND schools.StatusType = 'Active' ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank, sc.School AS school_name, sc.CharterNum AS charter_number, s.AvgScrWrite AS writing_score FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL AND s.rtype = 'S';

SELECT CASE WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50 testers' WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100 testers' WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN '100-250 testers' END AS testing_volume_category, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read, AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write, AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_enrollment, AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS avg_pct_free, AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS avg_pct_frpm FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250 AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND sc.County = 'Fresno' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.Phone, s.Website, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.AdmEmail1, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumTstTakr, f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS CharterStatus, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Pct FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND sat.NumTstTakr >= 10 ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT frpm.CDSCode) AS total_schools, AVG(frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_enrollment, SUM(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count, SUM(CASE WHEN frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count, AVG(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_poverty_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT frpm."District Code") AS number_of_districts, AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) AS avg_sat_read, AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) AS avg_sat_math, AVG(satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_write, (SELECT frpm2."School Name" FROM frpm frpm2 WHERE frpm2."County Name" = 'Amador' AND frpm2."Low Grade" = '9' AND frpm2."High Grade" = '12' ORDER BY frpm2."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name, MAX(frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") AS largest_enrollment, SUM(CASE WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_schools FROM frpm LEFT JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Amador' AND frpm."Low Grade" = '9' AND frpm."High Grade" = '12'

SELECT AVG((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100) AS avg_free_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter != 1 OR s.Charter IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count, AVG(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score, SUM(CASE WHEN f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS very_high_count, SUM(CASE WHEN f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" <= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_count, SUM(CASE WHEN f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moderate_count FROM frpm f LEFT JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores t ON f.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700

SELECT sname AS school_name
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) > 0.1 AND sat.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School, f."Educational Option Type"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' AND sat.rtype = 'S'
AND (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores sat2 ON s2.CDSCode = sat2.cds WHERE s2.County = 'Riverside' AND sat2.rtype = 'S') > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND f."School Type" LIKE '%High%' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname AS SchoolName, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.Phone FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode WHERE sch.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (sch.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND sch.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')

WITH avg_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avgd
  FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, s.DOCType AS DOCType
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT avgd FROM avg_diff);

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '12' AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.City, f."Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 
    fr."School Name" AS school_name,
    fr."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    fr."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count_k12,
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_free_k12,
    fr."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_frpm_k12,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.County AS county,
    s.State AS state,
    fr."School Type" AS school_type,
    fr."District Type" AS district_type,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_school,
    fr."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
    fr."High Grade" AS high_grade,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_sat_read,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_write,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS num_sat_takers,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500
  FROM frpm fr
  JOIN schools s ON fr.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON fr.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE fr."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY fr."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 
    fr."School Name" AS school_name,
    fr."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    fr."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count_k12,
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_free_k12,
    fr."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_frpm_k12,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.County AS county,
    s.State AS state,
    fr."School Type" AS school_type,
    fr."District Type" AS district_type,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_school,
    fr."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
    fr."High Grade" AS high_grade,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_sat_read,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_write,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS num_sat_takers,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500
  FROM frpm fr
  JOIN schools s ON fr.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON fr.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE fr."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY fr."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 10
);

SELECT frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName,
       frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS FRPMCount,
       (frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") AS EligibilityRate,
       satscores.AvgScrRead AS AvgRead,
       satscores.AvgScrMath AS AvgMath,
       satscores.AvgScrWrite AS AvgWrite,
       (satscores.NumTstTakr * 1.0 / satscores.enroll12) AS SATParticipationRate,
       (satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) AS HighScorerRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT s.Website, f."School Name" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT 1.0 * frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND (schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson' OR schools.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS admin1, AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS admin2, AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS admin3 FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN (SELECT cds, (NumGE1500*1.0/NumTstTakr) AS rate
      FROM satscores
      WHERE rtype = 'S' AND NumTstTakr > 0 AND NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY rate ASC
      LIMIT 1) t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
SELECT s.Website FROM schools AS s JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND sat.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sc.OpenDate >= '1980-01-01' AND sc.OpenDate <= '1980-12-31';
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE sc.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.sname, sc.County, s.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) as rn
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'
)
SELECT sname
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
SELECT frpm.`Educational Option Type` FROM frpm JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AvgScrMath, cname FROM satscores WHERE rtype = 'S' ORDER BY (AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, r.AvgScrRead, r.AvgScrMath, r.AvgScrWrite, (r.AvgScrRead + r.AvgScrMath + r.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSAT, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (r.AvgScrRead + r.AvgScrMath + r.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Rank, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPMRate, (r.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / r.enroll12) AS ParticipationRate, AVG(r.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY r.dname) AS DistrictAvgWrite, (r.AvgScrWrite - AVG(r.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY r.dname)) AS WritingDiff FROM schools s JOIN satscores r ON s.CDSCode = r.cds JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE r.rtype = 'S' AND ((s.AdmFName1 = 'Vicki' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich') OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Vicki' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich') OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Vicki' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich'))

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31' AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)")
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOC = '52' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE County = 'Orange' AND StatusType = 'Merged'

WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY County
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) as max_cnt FROM closed_counts
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT County FROM closed_counts WHERE cnt = (SELECT max_cnt FROM max_count)
)
SELECT s.School AS "school name", s.ClosedDate AS "closure date"
FROM schools s
JOIN top_counties t ON s.County = t.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s.School;
SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, s.MailStreet AS PostalStreetAddress FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE ss.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY ss.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT s.MailStreet, ss.sname FROM satscores ss JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers FROM schools JOIN satscores s ON schools.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Fresno';
SELECT School, MailZip FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM schools WHERE County='Colusa') / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County='Humboldt'),0) AS school_ratio,
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM schools WHERE County='Colusa' AND Charter=1) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County='Humboldt' AND Charter=1),0) AS charter_ratio,
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS REAL) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Colusa' AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Humboldt' AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5),0) AS high_frpm_ratio,
  (SELECT AVG(f.AvgScrRead + f.AvgScrMath + f.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores f JOIN schools s ON f.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Colusa' AND f.rtype='S') / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(f.AvgScrRead + f.AvgScrMath + f.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores f JOIN schools s ON f.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Humboldt' AND f.rtype='S'),0) AS avg_sat_ratio,
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS REAL) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Colusa') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Humboldt'),0) AS total_frpm_ratio,
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS REAL) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Colusa') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Humboldt'),0) AS total_enrollment_ratio
SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext FROM schools s INNER JOIN (SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE rtype = 'S' ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332) AS sub ON s.CDSCode = sub.cds;
SELECT School, Phone, Ext FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'
SELECT DISTINCT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Percent, CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 25 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty' ELSE 'Low Poverty' END AS Poverty_Level, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumTstTakr, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS Enrollment_Rank FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds AND sat.rtype = 'S' WHERE s.County = 'San Joaquin' AND s.Virtual = 'P' AND s.Charter = 1

SELECT s.School AS school_name, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate, sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_read, sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_math, sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS size_rank FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.Charter = 1 AND s.DOC = '52' AND s.City = 'Hickman' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment, f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count, (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS free_meal_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s2.Charter = 0 AND (f2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f2."Enrollment (K-12)") < (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)")) AS overall_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s3 JOIN frpm f3 ON s3.CDSCode = f3.CDSCode WHERE s3.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s3.Charter = 0 AND (f3."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f3."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18) AS num_schools_in_county_with_low_free_meal FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.Charter = 0 AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18 ORDER BY free_meal_pct

SELECT School, City, AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS FullName FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT School, City, AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT School, City, AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType != 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio_percentage FROM schools s WHERE s.County = 'Santa Clara' AND s.Charter = 1

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, s.District, s.County, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Percent, sat.AvgScrRead AS SAT_Read, sat.AvgScrMath AS SAT_Math, sat.AvgScrWrite AS SAT_Write, (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS SAT_Total, (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_Enroll, (SELECT AVG(f2."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_FRPM, (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrRead) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_Read, (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_Math, (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_Write, (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrRead + sat2.AvgScrMath + sat2.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS County_Avg_Total, f."Enrollment (K-12)" - (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS Enrollment_Diff, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" - (SELECT AVG(f2."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS FRPM_Diff, sat.AvgScrRead - (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrRead) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS Read_Diff, sat.AvgScrMath - (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS Math_Diff, sat.AvgScrWrite - (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS Write_Diff, (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) - (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrRead + sat2.AvgScrMath + sat2.AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus') AS Total_Diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" DESC) AS FRPM_Rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS SAT_Rank FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND s.County = 'Stanislaus' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures FROM schools WHERE DOCType LIKE '%Community College District%' AND City = 'San Francisco' AND ClosedDate >= '1989-01-01' AND ClosedDate <= '1989-12-31';
SELECT "County" FROM schools WHERE "SOC" = '11' AND strftime('%Y', "ClosedDate") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY "County" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.NCESDist AS "NCES district ID", s.School AS "school name", s.Charter AS "charter status", s.StatusType AS "current operational status", s.OpenDate AS "opening date", f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment", CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty' ELSE 'Very Low Poverty' END AS "poverty classification", sat.AvgScrRead AS "SAT Reading", sat.AvgScrMath AS "SAT Math", sat.AvgScrWrite AS "SAT Writing", (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite)/3.0 AS "overall average SAT score", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS "enrollment ranking" FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds AND sat.rtype = 'S' WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools' AND s.SOC LIKE '3%' ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS active_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Closed' THEN 1 END) AS closed_count FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Alpine' AND f."School Type" = 'District Community Day Schools' AND s.StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
SELECT frpm.`District Code` AS "District Code" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.City = 'Fresno' AND schools.Magnet = 0;

SELECT frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_count FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND schools.City = 'Fremont';
SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.School LIKE '%Youth Authority%' AND schools.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
SELECT frpm.`Low Grade` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.NCESDist = '0613360' AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON' LIMIT 1;
SELECT "School Name", "School Type" FROM frpm WHERE "County Code" = '37' AND "NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
SELECT s.City FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Merced' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = '2' AND s.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT f.`School Name` AS SchoolName, CASE WHEN f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 THEN f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ELSE NULL END AS FRPM_Pct, CASE WHEN (f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty' WHEN (f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) >= 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty' WHEN (f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) < 50 THEN 'Low Poverty' ELSE NULL END AS PovertyLevel, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, CASE WHEN sch.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS CharterStatus FROM frpm f JOIN schools sch ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` IN ('9','10','11','12') ORDER BY FRPM_Pct DESC

WITH active AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' AND StatusType = 'Active'
),
common AS (
    SELECT GSserved, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM active GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.GSserved AS grade_span,
    SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_enrollment,
    COUNT(a.CDSCode) AS num_schools,
    AVG(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_enrollment,
    (SUM(frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) * 1.0 / SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`)) * 100 AS overall_frpm_percent,
    CASE
        WHEN (SUM(frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) * 1.0 / SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`)) > 0.75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (SUM(frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) * 1.0 / SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`)) >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS poverty_level,
    SUM(s.AvgScrRead * s.NumTstTakr) / NULLIF(SUM(s.NumTstTakr), 0) AS avg_sat_read,
    SUM(s.AvgScrMath * s.NumTstTakr) / NULLIF(SUM(s.NumTstTakr), 0) AS avg_sat_math,
    SUM(s.AvgScrWrite * s.NumTstTakr) / NULLIF(SUM(s.NumTstTakr), 0) AS avg_sat_write
FROM common c
JOIN active a ON a.GSserved = c.GSserved
JOIN frpm ON a.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON a.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY c.GSserved;

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.School, s.Charter,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)",
         f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
         sa.AvgScrRead, sa.AvgScrMath, sa.AvgScrWrite
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds AND sa.rtype = 'S'
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    AND s.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
    AND (f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm) OR f."Academic Year" IS NULL)
)
SELECT County,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt_virtual,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_charter,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_regular,
       SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment,
       AVG("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_frpm_pct,
       AVG(AvgScrRead) AS avg_sat_read,
       AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_sat_math,
       AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_write,
       (SELECT s2.School FROM schools s2
        LEFT JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.County = virtual_schools.County
          AND s2.Virtual = 'F'
          AND (f2."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm) OR f2."Academic Year" IS NULL)
        ORDER BY COALESCE(f2."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
       MAX("Enrollment (K-12)") AS largest_enrollment
FROM virtual_schools
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY cnt_virtual DESC;
SELECT School, Latitude, SOCType AS School_Type FROM schools ORDER BY Latitude DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.City AS city, f.`Low Grade` AS low_grade, s.School AS school_name FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.State = 'CA' ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.GSoffered FROM schools s WHERE ABS(s.Longitude) = (SELECT MAX(ABS(Longitude)) FROM schools) LIMIT 1;

WITH magnet_k8 AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.City
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
),
per_city AS (
  SELECT City, COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS school_count
  FROM magnet_k8
  GROUP BY City
),
aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.CDSCode) FROM magnet_k8 s2 JOIN frpm f ON s2.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types') AS mp_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) FROM magnet_k8) AS city_count
)
SELECT
  p.City,
  p.school_count,
  a.mp_count AS multiple_provision_count,
  a.city_count AS total_cities
FROM per_city p
CROSS JOIN aggregates a;

WITH admin_names AS (
  SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
name_counts AS (
  SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM admin_names GROUP BY first_name
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT first_name FROM name_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, a.District
FROM admin_names a
JOIN top2 t ON a.first_name = t.first_name
ORDER BY a.first_name, a.District;

SELECT (`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)`) AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, `District Code` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.AdmFName3 = 'Dustin';
SELECT District AS DISTRICT, County AS COUNTY, School AS SCHOOL, AdmLName1 AS ADMIN_LAST_NAME FROM schools WHERE CharterNum LIKE '%40';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND DOC = '54' AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01' AND OpenDate <= '2010-12-31' AND SOC = '62';

SELECT s.sname AS school_name, sch.AdmEmail1 AS admin_email FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores WHERE rtype = 'S') LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' WHEN AVG(A12) < AVG(A13) THEN '1996' ELSE 'equal' END AS higher_year FROM district

WITH district_rank AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11, d.A3,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A11 DESC) as salary_rank
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
),
female_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as female_count
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY district_id
),
active_loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT r.district_id
    FROM district_rank r
    JOIN female_counts f ON r.district_id = f.district_id
    WHERE r.salary_rank <= 3
      AND f.female_count >= 5
      AND r.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM active_loan_districts)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_female_clients,
       AVG( CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) ) AS avg_age
FROM client c
JOIN eligible_districts e ON c.district_id = e.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT dsp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d_max.A11)
        FROM client c_max
        JOIN district d_max ON c_max.district_id = d_max.district_id
        WHERE c_max.gender = 'F') - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dsp ON c.client_id = dsp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(cb.birth_date) FROM client cb WHERE cb.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dm.A11)
               FROM client cm
               JOIN district dm ON cm.district_id = dm.district_id
               WHERE cm.gender = 'F'
                 AND cm.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(cb2.birth_date) FROM client cb2 WHERE cb2.gender = 'F')
              );

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id AS account_number
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
AND dist.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT c.gender,
       CASE 
           WHEN CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS integer) < 30 THEN 'Young'
           WHEN CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS integer) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
           ELSE 'Senior'
       END AS age_group,
       d.A3 AS region,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_owners,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
GROUP BY c.gender, age_group, d.A3
ORDER BY c.gender, age_group, d.A3;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, COUNT(l.loan_id) as num_loans_total, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) as num_loans_active, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) as num_loans_completed, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) as total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) as avg_loan_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) as num_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) as total_transaction_amount, COUNT(cd.card_id) as num_cards, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cd.type) as card_types, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(cd.card_id) > 0 THEN 'Loan & Card' WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Loan Only' WHEN COUNT(cd.card_id) > 0 THEN 'Card Only' ELSE 'Account Only' END as service_category FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'DISPONENT' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC

WITH approved_loans AS (SELECT account_id, amount FROM loan WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1997' AND status = 'A'), min_amount AS (SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amt FROM approved_loans) SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN approved_loans al ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND al.amount = (SELECT min_amt FROM min_amount);

SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993')

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           (julianday(a.date) - julianday(c.birth_date))/365.25 AS age,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS open_year
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
      AND dist.A2 = 'Sokolov'
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT e.account_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS debt_loans
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON e.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT AVG(e.age) AS avg_age,
       COALESCE(SUM(ls.total_loans), 0) AS total_loans,
       COALESCE(SUM(ls.completed_loans), 0) AS completed_loans,
       COALESCE(SUM(ls.debt_loans), 0) AS debt_loans,
       MIN(e.open_year) AS earliest_year,
       MAX(e.open_year) AS latest_year
FROM eligible e
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON e.account_id = ls.account_id;
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM trans WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date <= '1995-12-31')

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id FROM account a INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01' AND t.date = (SELECT MAX(t2.date) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id) AND t.balance > 3000;

WITH card_clients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, ca.issued
  FROM card ca
  JOIN disp di ON ca.disp_id = di.disp_id
  JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE ca.issued = '1994-03-03'
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT di.client_id,
         COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
         COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans
  FROM disp di
  JOIN account a ON di.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY di.client_id
),
trans_agg AS (
  SELECT di.client_id,
         COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_trans,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount
  FROM disp di
  JOIN account a ON di.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY di.client_id
)
SELECT cc.client_id,
       cc.gender,
       cc.birth_date,
       CAST((JULIANDAY(cc.issued) - JULIANDAY(cc.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_card_issue,
       d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       COALESCE(t.num_trans, 0) AS num_transactions,
       COALESCE(t.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount,
       COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans,
       COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0) AS active_loans,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) > 0
            THEN CASE WHEN CAST((JULIANDAY(cc.issued) - JULIANDAY(cc.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 30
                      THEN 'Young borrower'
                      ELSE 'Mature borrower'
                 END
            ELSE NULL
       END AS borrower_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.gender ORDER BY CAST((JULIANDAY(cc.issued) - JULIANDAY(cc.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER)) AS rank_in_gender
FROM card_clients cc
JOIN district d ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg l ON cc.client_id = l.client_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t ON cc.client_id = t.client_id;

WITH target AS (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount = 840 AND date = '1998-10-14')
SELECT a.date AS opened_date, (julianday('1998-10-14') - julianday(a.date)) AS days_open, c.gender AS owner_gender, (strftime('%Y', '1998-10-14') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1998-10-14') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) AS owner_age, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date <= '1998-10-14') AS total_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp d2 JOIN card cd ON d2.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d2.account_id = target.account_id AND cd.issued <= '1998-10-14') AS cards_issued, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = target.account_id AND l.date < '1998-10-14') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_loan_before FROM target JOIN account a ON target.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON target.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id;

WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25')
SELECT
  (SELECT d.A2 FROM district d WHERE d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS district_name,
  (SELECT d.A3 FROM district d WHERE d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS district_region,
  (SELECT r.salary_rank FROM (SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A11 DESC) AS salary_rank FROM district) r WHERE r.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS salary_rank,
  (SELECT r.unemp_rank FROM (SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A12 ASC) AS unemp_rank FROM district) r WHERE r.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS unemp_rank,
  (SELECT (julianday('1994-08-25') - julianday(a.date)) FROM acct a) AS account_open_days,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS total_clients,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS male_count,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS female_count,
  (SELECT AVG((julianday('1994-08-25') - julianday(c.birth_date))/365.25) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM acct)) AS avg_age,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acct) AND t.date < '1994-08-25' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS num_transactions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acct) AND t.date < '1994-08-25' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy;

WITH target_client AS (
  SELECT disp.client_id FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21'
),
largest_trans AS (
  SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account
  FROM trans t
  JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE d.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM target_client)
  ORDER BY t.amount DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  lt.trans_id, lt.account_id, lt.date AS trans_date, lt.type, lt.operation, lt.amount, lt.balance, lt.k_symbol, lt.bank, lt.account AS trans_account,
  c.gender, c.birth_date,
  d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.loan_id || ':' || l.amount, ', ') FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = lt.account_id) AS loans_info,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(o.order_id || ':' || o.amount, ', ') FROM `order` o WHERE o.account_id = lt.account_id) AS orders_info
FROM largest_trans lt
JOIN disp ON lt.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE disp.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM target_client);

SELECT c.gender FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)) ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
SELECT d.disp_id FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id WHERE t.date = '1998-09-02' AND t.amount = 5100;

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS male_clients, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) AS female_clients, avg(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_age, sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits, sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals, count(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count, count(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.loan_id END) AS good_loans, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.loan_id END) AS bad_loans, coalesce(sum(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%m', a.date) BETWEEN '01' AND '03' THEN a.account_id END) AS q1_openings, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%m', a.date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN a.account_id END) AS q2_openings, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%m', a.date) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN a.account_id END) AS q3_openings, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%m', a.date) BETWEEN '10' AND '12' THEN a.account_id END) AS q4_openings FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id AND d.A3 = 'Litomerice' LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'

SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS account_opened, a.frequency, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A4 AS inhabitants, d.A5 AS municipalities_lt499, d.A6 AS municipalities_500_1999, d.A7 AS municipalities_2000_9999, d.A8 AS municipalities_gt10000, d.A9 AS number_of_cities, d.A10 AS urban_ratio, d.A11 AS avg_salary, d.A12 AS unemployment_95, d.A13 AS unemployment_96, d.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000, d.A15 AS crimes_95, d.A16 AS crimes_96, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_credits, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS sum_credits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_debits, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS sum_debits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS num_loans, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card c JOIN disp d2 ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id WHERE d2.account_id = a.account_id AND d2.client_id = cl.client_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER') AS num_cards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS num_orders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM `order` o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS sum_orders FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id AND cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29' LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT cl.birth_date AS birthday, CAST((julianday('1996-01-03') - julianday(cl.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_loan, d.A3 AS location, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(trans_id || ': ' || date || ' ' || type || ' ' || amount, ', ' ORDER BY date) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = ln.account_id AND t.date < '1996-01-03') AS transaction_history, (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN type='VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) END FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = ln.account_id AND t.date < '1996-01-03') AS expense_to_income_ratio, (SELECT MIN(balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = ln.account_id AND t.date < '1996-01-03') AS min_balance, (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = ln.account_id AND t.date < '1996-01-03') AS max_balance, (SELECT cd.type || ' issued ' || cd.issued FROM disp dp JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE dp.client_id = cl.client_id AND dp.account_id = ln.account_id LIMIT 1) AS credit_card_info, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = cl.client_id AND type='OWNER') AND l2.date < '1996-01-03') AS number_of_previous_loans FROM loan ln JOIN disp dp ON ln.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id WHERE ln.amount = 98832 AND ln.date = '1996-01-03' LIMIT 1;
SELECT account.account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A4 AS inhabitants, COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_clients, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.client_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.client_id), 2) END AS percentage_male FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE LOWER(A3) = 'south bohemia' ORDER BY A4 DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4;

SELECT
  ((SELECT t2.balance
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1)
      AND t2.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t2.date DESC
    LIMIT 1)
   -
   (SELECT t1.balance
    FROM trans t1
    WHERE t1.account_id = (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1)
      AND t1.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t1.date DESC
    LIMIT 1))
   * 100.0
   /
   (SELECT t1.balance
    FROM trans t1
    WHERE t1.account_id = (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1)
      AND t1.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t1.date DESC
    LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate;

SELECT d.A3 as region, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount) END as pct_amount_A, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) END as pct_loans_A, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN (l.payments * l.duration) - l.amount END) as avg_interest_A, AVG((l.payments * l.duration) - l.amount) as avg_interest_all FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY d.A3 ORDER BY region

SELECT d.A3 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END AS loan_size_category, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS region_percentage, AVG(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END) AS overall_percentage FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date AS account_opened,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A10 AS urban_ratio,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.status) AS loan_statuses,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS has_defaulted_loan
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
GROUP BY a.account_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND a.date >= '1995-01-01' AND a.date <= '2000-12-31'

SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opening_date, a.frequency, d.A2 AS district_name, c.client_id AS owner_client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS total_credits, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS total_debits, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS net_balance, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS transaction_count, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 0 AND COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 10 THEN 'High Activity' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id), 0) > 10 THEN 'Active Customer' ELSE 'Regular Customer' END AS customer_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = a.account_id AND trans.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id AND d.A2 = 'Prachatice' JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY rank

SELECT c.gender AS borrower_gender, c.birth_date AS borrower_birth_date, l.amount AS loan_amount, l.duration AS loan_duration, l.payments AS loan_payments, CASE l.status WHEN 'A' THEN 'Running - OK' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Finished - No Issues' WHEN 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues' ELSE l.status END AS status_description, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS avg_salary, d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_1995, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE a2.district_id = a.district_id AND l2.amount > l.amount) AS rank_in_district FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

WITH national_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(A11) AS avg_a11 FROM district
),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           MAX(amount) AS max_loan_amount,
           MIN(amount) AS min_loan_amount,
           SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_trans AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.frequency,
       a.date AS account_opened,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       al.num_loans,
       al.max_loan_amount,
       al.min_loan_amount,
       al.total_loan_amount,
       c.client_id AS owner_client_id,
       c.gender AS owner_gender,
       c.birth_date AS owner_birth_date,
       COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) AS net_income,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
           WHEN COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
           ELSE 'Low Income'
       END AS income_classification,
       COALESCE(at.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) > 0 THEN
               (at.total_income - at.total_expense) * 1.0 / at.total_income
           ELSE NULL
       END AS savings_ratio,
       RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY d.A3
           ORDER BY al.max_loan_amount DESC
       ) AS rank_in_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN account_loans al ON a.account_id = al.account_id
LEFT JOIN disp disp_owner ON a.account_id = disp_owner.account_id AND disp_owner.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON disp_owner.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN account_trans at ON a.account_id = at.account_id
CROSS JOIN national_avg na
WHERE al.max_loan_amount > 300000
  AND d.A11 > na.avg_a11
  AND (COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) > 0
       OR at.account_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY al.max_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.date AS loan_date,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary,
        d.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.district_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.duration = 60
)
SELECT
    rl.district_name,
    rl.avg_salary,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.amount,
    rl.loan_date,
    rl.duration,
    rl.payments,
    rl.status,
    (rl.payments - rl.amount) * 100.0 / rl.amount AS interest_rate,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = rl.account_id) AS transaction_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
LEFT JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = rl.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 3
ORDER BY rl.avg_salary DESC, rl.amount DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A3 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A15) AS increment_pct FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT strftime('%m', a.date) AS month_num, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS decin_pct, (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)) AS avg_income_tx_count, (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)) AS avg_expense_tx_count, CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*)) > (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN d2.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM account a2 JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993') THEN 'above' WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*)) < (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN d2.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM account a2 JOIN district d2 ON a2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993') THEN 'below' ELSE 'equal' END AS comparison FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' GROUP BY strftime('%m', a.date) ORDER BY month_num

WITH monthly_accounts AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency FROM account a WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'),
 client_info AS (SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, dis.A2 AS district_name FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM monthly_accounts)),
 transaction_agg AS (SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM monthly_accounts) GROUP BY t.account_id),
 loan_agg AS (SELECT l.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_loan_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_completed_loan_amount FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM monthly_accounts) GROUP BY l.account_id)
 SELECT m.account_id, ci.gender AS client_gender, ci.birth_date AS client_birth_date, ci.district_id AS client_district_id, ci.district_name, COALESCE(t.transaction_count,0) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(t.total_income,0) AS total_income, COALESCE(t.total_expense,0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(t.total_income,0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense,0) AS net_cash_flow, COALESCE(l.active_loans,0) AS active_loans, COALESCE(l.completed_loans,0) AS completed_loans, COALESCE(l.total_active_loan_amount,0) AS total_active_loan_amount, COALESCE(l.total_completed_loan_amount,0) AS total_completed_loan_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.transaction_count,0) DESC) AS rank_transaction_volume, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(t.total_income,0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense,0)) DESC) AS rank_cash_flow
 FROM monthly_accounts m
 LEFT JOIN client_info ci ON m.account_id = ci.account_id
 LEFT JOIN transaction_agg t ON m.account_id = t.account_id
 LEFT JOIN loan_agg l ON m.account_id = l.account_id
 ORDER BY m.account_id;

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_holders FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY num_female_holders DESC LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(*) AS withdrawal_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY withdrawal_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp WHERE client_id = c.client_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp d2 JOIN card ca ON d2.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id)

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M'
SELECT A3 AS branch_location, A2 AS district_name FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district)

SELECT district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS region, district.A4 AS population, district.A16 AS number_of_crimes_1996, (district.A16 - district.A15) * 100.0 / district.A15 AS pct_increase, COUNT(account.account_id) AS num_accounts FROM district LEFT JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id GROUP BY district.district_id ORDER BY district.A16 DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (SELECT a.account_id FROM account a WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0)) SELECT (SELECT AVG(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts) AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0) AS avg_neg_balance, (SELECT MAX(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts) AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0) AS max_withdrawal_amount, (SELECT AVG(card_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count FROM eligible_accounts ea LEFT JOIN disp d ON ea.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id GROUP BY ea.account_id)) AS avg_cards_per_account, (SELECT COUNT(c.card_id) FROM eligible_accounts ea JOIN disp d ON ea.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE c.type = 'gold') AS total_gold_cards, (SELECT AVG(age) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id, (strftime('%Y','2000-01-01') - strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','2000-01-01') < strftime('%m-%d', cl.birth_date)) AS age FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts))) AS avg_owner_age, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.gender = 'F' THEN cl.client_id END) FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts)) AS female_owners, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.gender = 'M' THEN cl.client_id END) FROM client cl JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts)) AS male_owners

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND loan.amount >= 250000 AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND loan.status = 'A'

WITH owner_list AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.type='OWNER' AND a.district_id=1
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id AND l.status IN ('C','D'))
),
owner_accounts AS (
  SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.type='OWNER' AND a.district_id=1
    AND d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM owner_list)
),
owner_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ol.client_id,
    c.gender,
    (julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS age,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount - l.payments * l.duration), 0) FROM loan l
     JOIN owner_accounts oa ON l.account_id = oa.account_id AND oa.client_id = ol.client_id
     WHERE l.status IN ('C','D')) AS total_remaining_debt,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM card cd JOIN owner_accounts oa2 ON cd.disp_id = oa2.disp_id AND oa2.client_id = ol.client_id
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_card,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t
     JOIN owner_accounts oa3 ON t.account_id = oa3.account_id AND oa3.client_id = ol.client_id) AS total_trans,
    (SELECT AVG(latest.bal) FROM (
       SELECT t2.balance AS bal
       FROM owner_accounts oa4
       JOIN trans t2 ON t2.account_id = oa4.account_id
       WHERE oa4.client_id = ol.client_id
       AND t2.trans_id = (SELECT trans_id FROM trans t3 WHERE t3.account_id = oa4.account_id ORDER BY t3.date DESC, t3.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)
    ) latest) AS avg_balance
  FROM owner_list ol
  JOIN client c ON ol.client_id = c.client_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_remaining_debt) AS avg_remaining_debt,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN gender='M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN gender='F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
  AVG(age) AS avg_age,
  AVG(has_card) * 100 AS card_ownership_pct,
  SUM(total_trans) AS total_transactions,
  AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
FROM owner_stats;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT district_id, A15 FROM district ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
),
male_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client c JOIN target t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
disp_data AS (
    SELECT d.disp_id, d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_clients)
),
loan_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.loan_id, d.client_id, l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_clients)
),
card_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.card_id, d.disp_id, d.client_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_clients)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients) AS total_male_clients,
    (SELECT A15 FROM target) AS crime_count_1995,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM disp_data) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) FROM loan_data) AS total_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) FROM card_data) AS total_credit_cards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM disp_data) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients) AS avg_dispositions_per_client,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) FROM loan_data) AS num_clients_with_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients mc WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', mc.birth_date) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', mc.birth_date))) < 30) AS young_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients mc WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', mc.birth_date) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', mc.birth_date))) BETWEEN 30 AND 50) AS middle_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_clients mc WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', mc.birth_date) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', mc.birth_date))) > 50) AS senior_count
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy;

SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age, AVG(acc.avg_balance) AS avg_balance
FROM (
    SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
    HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 1000
) acc
JOIN account a ON acc.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id AND cd.type = 'gold'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
GROUP BY c.gender;

WITH pisek_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pisek_accounts) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(COUNT(t.trans_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a2.account_id), 0), 0) FROM pisek_accounts a2 LEFT JOIN trans t ON a2.account_id = t.account_id) AS avg_tx_per_account,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM pisek_accounts a2 JOIN trans t ON a2.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_deposits,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM pisek_accounts a2 JOIN trans t ON a2.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_withdrawals,
    (SELECT AVG(max_bal) FROM (SELECT a2.account_id, MAX(t.balance) AS max_bal FROM pisek_accounts a2 JOIN trans t ON a2.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a2.account_id) sub) AS avg_max_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_credit_cards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_loans,
