    (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount)) END FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS active_loan_pct,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FROM disp d WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS unique_owners
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy);

SELECT DISTINCT d.A3 AS district FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND t.amount > 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek'

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE card.type = 'gold'
)
SELECT
    g.account_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM disp d2
     JOIN card c2 ON d2.disp_id = c2.disp_id
     WHERE d2.account_id = g.account_id
       AND c2.type = 'gold') AS num_gold_cards,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
    MIN(t.balance) AS min_balance,
    MAX(t.balance) AS max_balance,
    (SELECT t2.balance
     FROM trans t2
     WHERE t2.account_id = g.account_id
     ORDER BY t2.date DESC, t2.trans_id DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS current_balance,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS good_loan_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loan_total,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(t.balance) DESC) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts g
JOIN account a ON g.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON g.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY g.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
ORDER BY avg_balance DESC;

SELECT district.A3 AS region, district.A2 AS district, client.gender, card.type AS card_type, AVG(trans.amount) AS avg_transaction, SUM(trans.amount) AS total_spending, district.A11 AS district_avg_salary, CAST(SUM(trans.amount) AS REAL) / district.A11 AS ratio_total_to_salary FROM trans JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND trans.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' GROUP BY district.A3, district.A2, client.gender, card.type

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t2.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  );

SELECT c.client_id,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cd.type) FROM disp d JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS card_types,
  (SELECT MAX(cd.issued) FROM disp d JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS latest_card_issued,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE l.status WHEN 'A' THEN 'Good Standing' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Default' ELSE l.status END) FROM disp d JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS loan_statuses,
  (SELECT COUNT(t.trans_id) FROM disp d JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS num_transactions,
  (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM disp d JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS total_trans_amount,
  (SELECT AVG(t.balance) FROM disp d JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS avg_balance,
  (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END FROM disp d JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS savings_rate,
  (SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM disp d JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS total_loan_amount,
  (SELECT 1 + COUNT(*) 
   FROM (SELECT d2.client_id, SUM(l2.amount) AS total_loan 
         FROM disp d2 JOIN loan l2 ON d2.account_id = l2.account_id 
         JOIN client c2 ON d2.client_id = c2.client_id 
         WHERE c2.district_id = c.district_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER' 
           AND c2.gender = 'F' 
           AND (julianday('now') - julianday(c2.birth_date)) / 365.25 >= 18 
         GROUP BY d2.client_id) sub 
   WHERE sub.total_loan > (SELECT SUM(l3.amount) 
                           FROM disp d3 JOIN loan l3 ON d3.account_id = l3.account_id 
                           WHERE d3.client_id = c.client_id AND d3.type = 'OWNER')) AS regional_loan_rank
FROM client c
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND (julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 >= 18
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp d WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' 
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id) 
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id))
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH female_owners AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, disp.account_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER' WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'), owner_metrics AS (SELECT fo.district_name, fo.client_id, fo.birth_date, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) AS total_loan_amount FROM female_owners fo LEFT JOIN trans t ON fo.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON fo.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY fo.district_name, fo.client_id, fo.birth_date) SELECT om.district_name, CASE WHEN om.birth_date > '1980-01-01' THEN 'Young' WHEN om.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, AVG(om.trans_count) AS avg_transaction_activity, AVG(om.net_balance) AS avg_net_balance, AVG(om.total_loan_amount) AS avg_loan_amount, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(l2.loan_id) > 0 THEN 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l2.status='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l2.loan_id) ELSE 0 END FROM female_owners fo2 JOIN loan l2 ON fo2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE fo2.district_name = om.district_name AND CASE WHEN fo2.birth_date > '1980-01-01' THEN 'Young' WHEN fo2.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END = CASE WHEN om.birth_date > '1980-01-01' THEN 'Young' WHEN om.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END) AS active_loan_rate FROM owner_metrics om GROUP BY om.district_name, CASE WHEN om.birth_date > '1980-01-01' THEN 'Young' WHEN om.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END ORDER BY om.district_name, age_group

WITH owners AS ( SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 ), t AS ( SELECT dp.client_id, t2.balance, t2.trans_id FROM disp dp JOIN trans t2 ON dp.account_id = t2.account_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' ), l AS ( SELECT dp.client_id, l2.loan_id, l2.status FROM disp dp JOIN loan l2 ON dp.account_id = l2.account_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' ) SELECT o.client_id, o.district_name, o.gender, o.birth_date, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', o.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', o.birth_date)) AS age, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS good_loans, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS bad_loans, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'Bad' ELSE 'Good' END AS credit_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(t.balance) DESC) AS priority_rank FROM owners o LEFT JOIN t ON o.client_id = t.client_id LEFT JOIN l ON o.client_id = l.client_id GROUP BY o.client_id, o.district_name, o.gender, o.birth_date
SELECT DISTINCT d.type FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE d.type != 'OWNER' AND ds.A11 > 8000 AND ds.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT d.a2 AS district_name,
       d.a3 AS region,
       d.a4 AS population,
       COUNT(*) AS num_withdrawals,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withd_amount,
       SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / d.a4 AS withdrawal_per_capita,
       CASE WHEN d.a12 > 2.0 THEN 'High'
            WHEN d.a12 >= 1.0 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
       END AS unempl_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4
ORDER BY rank;
SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes FROM district d WHERE d.A15 > 4000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id AND a.date >= '1997-01-01')

WITH classic_owner_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.account_id
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE card.type = 'classic' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
district_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS num_holders
    FROM classic_owner_clients
    GROUP BY district_id
),
account_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
district_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT coc.district_id, AVG(ab.balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM classic_owner_clients coc
    JOIN account_balance ab ON coc.account_id = ab.account_id
    GROUP BY coc.district_id
),
district_loans AS (
    SELECT coc.district_id, l.amount, l.status
    FROM classic_owner_clients coc
    JOIN loan l ON coc.account_id = l.account_id
),
district_avg_loan AS (
    SELECT district_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
           AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS loan_performance
    FROM district_loans
    GROUP BY district_id
)
SELECT d.district_id,
       COALESCE(dc.num_holders, 0) AS num_holders,
       dal.avg_loan_amount,
       dab.avg_account_balance,
       dal.loan_performance,
       d.A11 AS district_salary,
       d.A12 AS unemployment_rate
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN district_counts dc ON d.district_id = dc.district_id
LEFT JOIN district_avg_balance dab ON d.district_id = dab.district_id
LEFT JOIN district_avg_loan dal ON d.district_id = dal.district_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT dp.disp_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS avg_accounts_per_client, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c2.card_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS avg_cards_per_client, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS avg_loans_per_client, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.loan_id ELSE NULL END) AS total_good_loans, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.loan_id ELSE NULL END) AS total_bad_loans, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS avg_total_income_per_client, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS avg_total_expense_per_client, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_income_transactions, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_expense_transactions FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN card c2 ON c2.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'Prague' GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY age_group;

SELECT COALESCE(d.A3, 'Overall') AS region, (SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM card c JOIN disp ON c.disp_id = disp.disp_id JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.type = 'gold' GROUP BY d.A3 WITH ROLLUP

WITH max_loan AS (
  SELECT account_id, amount AS loan_amount FROM loan ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN max_loan ml ON d.account_id = ml.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.client_id,
  c.gender,
  c.birth_date,
  CASE
    WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
    ELSE 'Senior'
  END AS age_category,
  d2.A2 AS district_name,
  d2.A12 AS district_unemployment_rate,
  CASE WHEN d2.A12 > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high_unemployment,
  ml.loan_amount,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
     FROM trans t
     JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
     WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
    ), 0
  ) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
     FROM trans t
     JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
     WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    ), 0
  ) AS total_expense,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
       FROM trans t
       JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
       WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
      ), 0
    ) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
       FROM trans t
       JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
       WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
      ), 0
    ) - COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
       FROM trans t
       JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
       WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      ), 0
    )) * 100.0 / COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(t.amount)
       FROM trans t
       JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
       WHERE d.client_id = owner.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
      ), 0
    )
  END AS savings_rate
FROM owner
JOIN client c ON owner.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
CROSS JOIN max_loan ml

SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.A15 AS crime_1995, d.A16 AS crime_1996, CASE WHEN d.A15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15 END AS pct_change, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A16 DESC) AS crime_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id = a.account_id) AS num_loans, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = a.account_id) AS num_trans, (SELECT AVG(A16) FROM district) AS avg_crime_all, CASE WHEN d.A16 > (SELECT AVG(A16) FROM district) THEN 'above' ELSE 'below' END AS crime_comparison FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.account_id = 532

SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount AS trans_amount, t.balance AS trans_balance, t.k_symbol AS trans_k_symbol, t.bank, t.account AS trans_account, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS avg_salary, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A11 DESC) AS salary_rank, (SELECT group_concat(c.client_id || ':' || di.type, ', ') FROM disp di JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id WHERE di.account_id = a.account_id) AS ownership_details, (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT l.status, ', ') FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS loan_statuses, o.order_id, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount AS order_amount, o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE o.order_id = 33333 ORDER BY t.date, t.trans_id;

SELECT trans.trans_id, trans.account_id, trans.date, trans.type, trans.operation, trans.amount, trans.balance, trans.k_symbol, trans.bank, trans.account FROM trans JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id WHERE disp.client_id = 3356 AND trans.operation = 'VYBER';
SELECT count(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amount < 200000

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS avg_salary, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A11 > d.A11) AS salary_rank, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(crd.type || ' (issued ' || crd.issued || ')', ', ') FROM card crd JOIN disp dp ON crd.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id) AS cards, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card crd JOIN disp dp ON crd.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND crd.type='gold') THEN 'Premium' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card crd JOIN disp dp ON crd.disp_id = dp.disp_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND crd.type='classic' AND crd.issued < date('now','-5 years')) THEN 'Long-term Classic' ELSE 'Standard' END AS segment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN disp dp ON l.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type='OWNER') AS loan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t JOIN disp dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id) AS transaction_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM trans t JOIN disp dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND t.type='PRIJEM') AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM trans t JOIN disp dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND t.type='VYDAJ') AS total_expense FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.client_id = 13539;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS num_loans, COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(t.total_incoming, 0) AS total_incoming, COALESCE(t.total_outgoing, 0) AS total_outgoing, COALESCE(t.total_incoming, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_outgoing, 0) AS net_balance, COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.client_id) FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE d2.A3 = d.A3 AND c2.client_id != 3541) AS other_clients_in_region FROM disp di JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account a ON di.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan GROUP BY account_id ) l ON a.account_id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_incoming, SUM(CASE WHEN type='VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_outgoing, COUNT(trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE c.client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) DESC

SELECT d.A3 AS district FROM loan l INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, o.bank_to, o.account_to, o.amount, o.k_symbol, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = o.account_id) AS loan_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l2.status) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id = o.account_id) AS loan_statuses, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id),0) AS total_income, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id),0) AS total_expense, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = o.account_id),0) AS net_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card ca WHERE ca.disp_id = (SELECT disp_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.account_id = o.account_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER')) AS num_credit_cards FROM `order` o JOIN disp d_owner ON d_owner.account_id = o.account_id AND d_owner.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d_owner.client_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE o.order_id = 32423
SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.trans_id END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS incoming_txns,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.trans_id END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS outgoing_txns,
    (SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS total_loans,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS good_loans,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS bad_loans,
    (SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS avg_loan_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(t.balance) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS avg_current_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS male_clients,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik') AS female_clients;
SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'junior' AND card.issued >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A11 > 10000;

WITH male_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
loan_sums AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_1996,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_1997
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM male_accounts)
)
SELECT (sum_1997 - sum_1996) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sum_1996, 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM loan_sums;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_withdrawals FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date > '1995-12-31';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS difference;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM disp WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT');

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND operation = 'VYPIS') AS cnt, (SELECT k_symbol FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY k_symbol HAVING SUM(amount) = 3539) AS aim;
SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.account_id = 130 AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT d.A3 AS region,
       d.district_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A11 AS avg_salary,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM account a
        JOIN disp dn ON a.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
        WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
          AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU') AS num_accounts,
       (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0 * loan_cnt / cnt END
        FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
              FROM account a
              JOIN disp dn ON a.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
              WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
                AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU') t1,
             (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS loan_cnt
              FROM account a
              JOIN disp dn ON a.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
              LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
              WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
                AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
                AND l.loan_id IS NOT NULL) t2) AS loan_adoption_rate,
       (SELECT AVG(l2.amount)
        FROM account a2
        JOIN disp dn ON a2.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
        LEFT JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
        WHERE a2.district_id = d.district_id
          AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
          AND l2.loan_id IS NOT NULL) AS avg_loan_amount,
       (SELECT COUNT(t3.trans_id)
        FROM account a3
        JOIN disp dn ON a3.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
        LEFT JOIN trans t3 ON a3.account_id = t3.account_id
        WHERE a3.district_id = d.district_id
          AND a3.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU') AS total_transactions,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(latest.balance), 0)
        FROM (SELECT a4.account_id,
                     (SELECT t4.balance
                      FROM trans t4
                      WHERE t4.account_id = a4.account_id
                      ORDER BY t4.trans_id DESC
                      LIMIT 1) AS balance
              FROM account a4
              JOIN disp dn ON a4.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
              WHERE a4.district_id = d.district_id
                AND a4.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU') AS latest) AS total_balance
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT a5.district_id
                        FROM account a5
                        JOIN disp dn ON a5.account_id = dn.account_id AND dn.type = 'OWNER'
                        WHERE a5.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU')
ORDER BY d.A3, d.district_id

SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount AS debt, l.status, l.payments FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.client_id = 992;
SELECT t.balance, c.gender FROM disp d JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE d.client_id = 4 AND d.type = 'OWNER' AND t.trans_id = 851;

SELECT c.gender, c.birth_date, (SELECT cc.type FROM disp d2 JOIN card cc ON d2.disp_id = cc.disp_id WHERE d2.client_id = 9 ORDER BY cc.issued DESC LIMIT 1) AS credit_card_type, (SELECT cc.issued FROM disp d3 JOIN card cc ON d3.disp_id = cc.disp_id WHERE d3.client_id = 9 ORDER BY cc.issued DESC LIMIT 1) AS card_issued, CASE WHEN (SELECT cc.type FROM disp d4 JOIN card cc ON d4.disp_id = cc.disp_id WHERE d4.client_id = 9 ORDER BY cc.issued DESC LIMIT 1) = 'gold' THEN 'Premium Customer' WHEN (SELECT cc.type FROM disp d5 JOIN card cc ON d5.disp_id = cc.disp_id WHERE d5.client_id = 9 ORDER BY cc.issued DESC LIMIT 1) = 'classic' THEN 'Regular Customer' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS customer_status, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT da.account_id) FROM disp da WHERE da.client_id = 9 AND da.type = 'OWNER') AS total_accounts, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', (SELECT cc.issued FROM disp d6 JOIN card cc ON d6.disp_id = cc.disp_id WHERE d6.client_id = 9 ORDER BY cc.issued DESC LIMIT 1))) AS card_age FROM client c WHERE c.client_id = 9

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.client_id = 617 AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT client.client_id, account.account_id FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31' AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

WITH top_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.client_id
    ORDER BY MAX(l.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    d.A2 AS location,
    (l.payments * l.duration) AS total_payments,
    (l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) AS interest_paid,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp dp2 JOIN trans t ON dp2.account_id = t.account_id WHERE dp2.client_id = c.client_id) AS transaction_activity,
    CASE
        WHEN d.A11 > 2 * l.amount THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.A11 > l.amount THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS income_category,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) -
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM top_clients tc
JOIN client c ON tc.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM disp dp3 JOIN loan l2 ON dp3.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE dp3.client_id = c.client_id)
ORDER BY l.amount DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_male_customers FROM client c INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN `order` o ON d.account_id = o.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01' AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND o.amount > 4000;

WITH beroun_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' AND a.date > '1996-12-31'
)
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y', a.date) AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS num_male_owners,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) AS num_female_owners,
  AVG((julianday(a.date) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_owner_age,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expenses,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(l.loan_id)
  ELSE NULL END AS loan_success_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ca.type = 'gold' THEN 1 END) AS num_gold_cards,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ca.type = 'classic' THEN 1 END) AS num_classic_cards,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ca.type NOT IN ('gold','classic') THEN 1 END) AS num_other_cards
FROM beroun_accounts a
LEFT JOIN disp dsp ON dsp.account_id = a.account_id AND dsp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dsp.client_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN disp cd ON cd.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = cd.disp_id
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS customer_count FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND cd.type = 'junior'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS proportion
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') sub;

WITH weekly_owners AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weekly_owners) AS owner_count, (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(COUNT(t.trans_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weekly_owners), 0), 0) FROM weekly_owners wo JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = wo.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id) AS avg_transactions, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wo.client_id) FROM weekly_owners wo JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = wo.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id) AS credit_card_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wo.client_id FROM weekly_owners wo LEFT JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = wo.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY wo.client_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) > 10000)) AS high_volume_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) FROM weekly_owners wo JOIN client c ON c.client_id = wo.client_id) AS district_count, (SELECT COALESCE(AVG((SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = d.account_id ORDER BY t.date DESC LIMIT 1)), 0) FROM weekly_owners wo JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = wo.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER') AS avg_balance

WITH min_loan AS (
  SELECT MIN(l.amount) AS min_amount
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration > 24 AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.date AS account_open_date,
       a.frequency,
       d1.A2 AS account_district,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.gender) AS genders,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.birth_date) AS birth_dates,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d2.A2) AS client_districts,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_ids,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cd.type) AS card_types,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_ids
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN min_loan m ON l.amount = m.min_amount
LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN district d1 ON a.district_id = d1.district_id
LEFT JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN card cd ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 24 AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date, a.frequency, d1.A2;

SELECT d.account_id AS account_number FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F') AND dist.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM client cl JOIN district dst ON cl.district_id = dst.district_id WHERE cl.gender = 'F')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS total_clients, (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN gender='F' THEN 1 END) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS female_clients, (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN gender='M' THEN 1 END) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS male_clients, (SELECT d2.A2 FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c2.birth_date) = '1920' AND d2.A3 = 'east Bohemia' GROUP BY c2.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_district, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsp.account_id) FROM disp dsp JOIN client c3 ON dsp.client_id = c3.client_id JOIN district d3 ON c3.district_id = d3.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c3.birth_date) = '1920' AND d3.A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS total_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT dsp2.account_id FROM disp dsp2 JOIN client c4 ON dsp2.client_id = c4.client_id JOIN district d4 ON c4.district_id = d4.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c4.birth_date) = '1920' AND d4.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS loan_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l2.amount), 0) FROM loan l2 WHERE l2.account_id IN (SELECT dsp3.account_id FROM disp dsp3 JOIN client c5 ON dsp3.client_id = c5.client_id JOIN district d5 ON c5.district_id = d5.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c5.birth_date) = '1920' AND d5.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS total_loan_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT dsp4.account_id FROM disp dsp4 JOIN client c6 ON dsp4.client_id = c6.client_id JOIN district d6 ON c6.district_id = d6.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c6.birth_date) = '1920' AND d6.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS transaction_count, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id IN (SELECT dsp5.account_id FROM disp dsp5 JOIN client c7 ON dsp5.client_id = c7.client_id JOIN district d7 ON c7.district_id = d7.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c7.birth_date) = '1920' AND d7.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS total_income, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t3.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t3.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans t3 WHERE t3.account_id IN (SELECT dsp6.account_id FROM disp dsp6 JOIN client c8 ON dsp6.client_id = c8.client_id JOIN district d8 ON c8.district_id = d8.district_id WHERE strftime('%Y', c8.birth_date) = '1920' AND d8.A3 = 'east Bohemia')) AS total_expenses

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_amount, AVG(l.payments) AS avg_payment, AVG((l.payments * 24 - l.amount) / l.amount * 50.0) AS avg_interest_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_count, AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary, AVG(d.A12) AS avg_unemp95, AVG(d.A13) AS avg_unemp96 FROM (SELECT * FROM loan WHERE duration = 24 AND account_id IN (SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 50) l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('C','D') AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id AS district FROM client c INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.client_id NOT IN (SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE type = 'DISPONENT') ORDER BY c.client_id;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

WITH bond_type_counts AS ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ), max_type AS ( SELECT bond_type FROM bond_type_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM max_type)) AS total_occurrences, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM max_type)) AS molecules_count, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM max_type)) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM max_type)) AS unique_element_pairs_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.label) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM max_type)) AS labels

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-') AS molecule_count,
  (SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-') AS avg_chlorine_atoms,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS max_chlorine_atoms,
  (SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 'cl') AND m.label = '-') AS avg_bonds,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 'cl') AND m.label = '-' GROUP BY b.molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))) AS more_single_than_double_count,
  (SELECT 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN atom a ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-' AND b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element='cl'))
                 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '-')) AS avg_chlorine_bonds;

SELECT AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'o')) AS avg_oxygen FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '-')

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label='+') AND bond_type='-') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label='+')) AS average_single_bonds
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'na' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'c') AS carbon_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'n') AS nitrogen_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#') AS total_triple_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' 
     AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a.element = 'n') = 2
    ) AS nn_triple_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' 
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a.element = 'c')
    ) AS c_triple_bonds
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#')
ORDER BY total_triple_bonds;
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#'

SELECT (SELECT AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a.atom_id OR atom_id2 = a.atom_id)) FROM atom a WHERE a.element != 'br' AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT molecule_id FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) AS avg_connections, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.element != 'br' AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT molecule_id FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a.atom_id OR atom_id2 = a.atom_id) > 2) AS count_gt2;

SELECT 
  AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)) AS avg_atoms,
  AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'c')) AS avg_carbon_atoms,
  AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds,
  AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=')) AS avg_double_bonds,
  AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT c2.atom_id2 FROM connected c2 JOIN atom a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  ))) AS avg_connected_atoms,
  AVG(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) > 0 
       THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) 
                  FROM connected c 
                  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
                  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
                  WHERE a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
                    AND a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c') AS REAL) / 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)
       ELSE 0.0 END) AS avg_c_c_ratio
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND m.label = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom a 
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element IN ('c','h')
  )

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COALESCE(a.cnt_atoms,0) AS num_atoms, COALESCE(b.cnt_bonds,0) AS num_bonds, COALESCE(a.cnt_carbon,0) AS num_carbon, COALESCE(a.cnt_chlorine,0) AS num_chlorine, COALESCE(b.cnt_double,0) AS num_double_bonds, COALESCE(c.cnt_conn,0) AS num_connections FROM molecule m JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_atoms, SUM(element='c') AS cnt_carbon, SUM(element='cl') AS cnt_chlorine FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING SUM(element='c') > 0) a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_bonds, SUM(bond_type='=') AS cnt_double FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a1.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_conn FROM connected co JOIN atom a1 ON co.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON co.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND co.atom_id < co.atom_id2 GROUP BY a1.molecule_id) c ON m.molecule_id = c.molecule_id ORDER BY num_carbon DESC, num_atoms DESC
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2) WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom), 2) AS percentage, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(label, ', ') FROM (SELECT m2.label FROM atom a2 JOIN connected c2 ON a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id JOIN bond b2 ON c2.bond_id = b2.bond_id JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id WHERE b2.bond_type = '=' AND a2.element = a.element GROUP BY m2.molecule_id LIMIT 3)) AS example_molecules FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY a.element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) > 0

WITH mol_stats AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'h') AS h_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-') AS single_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=') AS double_count
  FROM molecule m
),
label_agg AS (
  SELECT label,
    SUM(h_count) AS total_h,
    COUNT(*) AS molecule_count,
    AVG(h_count) AS avg_h,
    AVG(bond_count) AS avg_bonds,
    SUM(single_count) AS total_single,
    SUM(double_count) AS total_double
  FROM mol_stats
  GROUP BY label
)
SELECT total_h, avg_h, avg_bonds, total_single, total_double
FROM label_agg
ORDER BY total_h DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH chlorine_bonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE a.element = 'cl') SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS frequency, COUNT(DISTINCT a_noncl.atom_id) AS non_chlorine_atoms FROM chlorine_bonds cb JOIN bond b ON cb.bond_id = b.bond_id LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = cb.bond_id LEFT JOIN atom a_noncl ON (a_noncl.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a_noncl.atom_id = c.atom_id2) AND a_noncl.element != 'cl' GROUP BY b.bond_type ORDER BY frequency DESC

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS elements FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine' WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon' WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen' WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 'Oxygen' WHEN a.element = 's' THEN 'Sulfur' WHEN a.element = 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen' WHEN a.element = 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus' WHEN a.element = 'na' THEN 'Sodium' WHEN a.element = 'br' THEN 'Bromine' WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 'Fluorine' WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN 'Iodine' WHEN a.element = 'sn' THEN 'Tin' WHEN a.element = 'pb' THEN 'Lead' WHEN a.element = 'te' THEN 'Tellurium' WHEN a.element = 'ca' THEN 'Calcium' ELSE a.element END AS element_name FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2) WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_types_count
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
LEFT JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS total_double_bond, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS count FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 's') AND m.molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_single_bonds FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

WITH RECURSIVE split(post_id, tag, rest) AS (
    SELECT p.Id, '', p.Tags FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes')
      AND p.CommentCount = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT post_id,
           CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, '>') > 0 THEN
               SUBSTR(rest, 2, INSTR(rest, '>') - 2)
           ELSE ''
           END,
           SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, '>') + 1)
    FROM split
    WHERE rest != ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT '' || tag AS tag FROM split WHERE tag != '';

WITH race_results AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId, r.points, r.milliseconds, ra.year
  FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.year < 1975
),
yearly_points AS (
  SELECT year, driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM race_results
  GROUP BY year, driverId
),
champions AS (
  SELECT year, driverId
  FROM (
    SELECT year, driverId, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rnk
    FROM yearly_points
  ) t WHERE rnk = 1
),
champion_races AS (
  SELECT c.year, rr.milliseconds
  FROM champions c
  JOIN race_results rr ON rr.year = c.year AND rr.driverId = c.driverId
  WHERE rr.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(milliseconds / 1000.0) AS avg_seconds
FROM champion_races
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
