SELECT r.year FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.year FROM lapTimes l JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId ORDER BY l.milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS ms FROM lapTimes WHERE lap = 1 GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY ms ASC LIMIT 5) ORDER BY ms DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM results WHERE raceId > 50 AND raceId < 100 AND statusId = 2 AND time IS NOT NULL;
SELECT name, location, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria'
SELECT raceId FROM results WHERE time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob FROM drivers d JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 23 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_qualifying_race AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, r.name, r.date, r.time
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE q.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM youngest_driver)
    ORDER BY r.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT strftime('%Y', date) AS year, name, date, time
FROM first_qualifying_race;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS count FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId WHERE d.nationality = 'American' AND s.status = 'Puncture'
SELECT c.url FROM constructors c JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.url ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.url FROM constructors c JOIN (SELECT cs.constructorId, SUM(season_wins) AS total_wins FROM (SELECT cs.constructorId, r.year, MAX(cs.wins) AS season_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY cs.constructorId, r.year) sub GROUP BY cs.constructorId ORDER BY total_wins DESC LIMIT 1) totals ON c.constructorId = totals.constructorId

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, lt.time FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND lt.lap = 3 AND lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(l2.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes l2 JOIN races r2 ON l2.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE r2.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND l2.lap = 3);

SELECT r.name AS race_name, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
FROM lapTimes l
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
WHERE l.lap = 1
GROUP BY r.raceId
ORDER BY fastest_ms
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':')-1) AS REAL)*60 + CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':')+1) AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix' AND r.rank < 11;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, ROUND(AVG(p.milliseconds)/1000.0, 3) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM drivers d JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985' GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY AVG(p.milliseconds)/1000.0 ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, r.time AS finish_time
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races rc ON rc.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE rc.year = 2008 AND rc.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1
SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, dob FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Austrian' AND dob >= '1981-01-01' AND dob <= '1991-12-31'
SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, url, dob FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND strftime('%Y', dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985' ORDER BY dob DESC;
SELECT location, country, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Hungaroring';

SELECT SUM(cr.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.constructorId
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(r.points) AS average_score FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.driverRef = 'hamilton' AND ra.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix';
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 10.0 AS annual_average FROM races WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
SELECT nationality FROM drivers GROUP BY nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(ds.wins) AS total_victories
FROM driverStandings ds
WHERE ds.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 90
);
SELECT r.name FROM races r JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.name || ', ' || c.location || ', ' || c.country AS racetrack_and_location FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId ORDER BY r.date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q3 ASC LIMIT 1;

WITH youngest AS (SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers) LIMIT 1) SELECT y.forename || ' ' || y.surname AS full_name, y.nationality, r.name AS first_race FROM youngest y JOIN results res ON y.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.date = (SELECT MIN(r2.date) FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE res2.driverId = y.driverId);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND results.statusId = 3 GROUP BY results.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE driverId = d.driverId AND position = 1) AS wins FROM drivers d WHERE d.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob ASC, driverId ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT MAX(CAST(duration AS REAL)) AS longest_pit_duration FROM pitStops
SELECT (SELECT MIN(ms) FROM (SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS ms FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.circuitId)) AS fastest_lap_record;
SELECT MAX(pitStops.duration) AS longest_duration FROM pitStops WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton');

SELECT p.lap FROM pitStops p JOIN races r ON p.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2011 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY p.stop;
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, ps.duration FROM pitStops ps JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2011 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT l.time, l.milliseconds FROM lapTimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes) LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE lt.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE driverRef = 'hamilton') ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT lt.time AS lap_record_time FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.circuitId = (SELECT r2.circuitId FROM races r2 WHERE r2.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix' LIMIT 1) ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, (SELECT lt.time FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r2 ON lt.raceId=r2.raceId WHERE r2.circuitId = c.circuitId ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1) AS lap_record FROM circuits c WHERE c.country = 'Italy';
SELECT r.name FROM races r JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Austria' ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_ms FROM pitStops ps WHERE ps.raceId = (SELECT l.raceId FROM lapTimes l JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.name LIKE '%Austrian%' OR c.location LIKE '%Austria%' OR c.country = 'Austria' ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1) AND ps.driverId = (SELECT l.driverId FROM lapTimes l JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.name LIKE '%Austrian%' OR c.location LIKE '%Austria%' OR c.country = 'Austria' ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1);
SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c WHERE c.circuitId IN (SELECT r.circuitId FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.circuitId HAVING MIN(lt.time) = '1:29.488')
SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_milliseconds FROM pitStops ps JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy';
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT height, player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS player_count FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS last_date FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.last_date WHERE pa.overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65 AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'low';
SELECT pa.player_api_id AS player_id FROM Player_Attributes pa GROUP BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(pa.crossing) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Team t JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(loss_cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS loss_cnt FROM Match WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal GROUP BY home_team_api_id) sub)
SELECT p.player_name, MAX(pa.penalties) AS max_penalties FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id GROUP BY p.player_api_id ORDER BY max_penalties DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY t.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS speed FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY team_api_id ORDER BY speed DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player.player_name, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(Player.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS current_age FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97 AND Player_Attributes.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' GROUP BY Player.player_api_id
SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.league_id) AS match_count FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id GROUP BY m.league_id ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(height) AS avg_height FROM Player WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00' AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00'
SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010' AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010')
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

WITH team_passing_2012 AS (SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) as avg_passing FROM Team_Attributes WHERE date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' GROUP BY team_api_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_passing) as overall_avg FROM team_passing_2012) SELECT t.team_long_name FROM team_passing_2012 tp JOIN Team t ON tp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id, overall_avg oa WHERE tp.avg_passing > oa.overall_avg;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN p.player_api_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';
SELECT l.name, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY total_goals ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS avg_long_shots FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT Player.player_name, AVG(Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player.height > 180 GROUP BY Player.player_api_id ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.chanceCreationPassing
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND SUBSTR(ta.date, 1, 4) = '2014'
  AND ta.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2014'
  )
ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY l.name HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal);
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1970' AND strftime('%m', birthday) = '10'
SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro' ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPositioningClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag' ORDER BY ta.date DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT PA.heading_accuracy FROM Player_Attributes PA JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00'

SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011' ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player)
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS count FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 130 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_fifa_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';
SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'David Wilson' ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT p.birthday FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';
SELECT AVG(Match.home_team_goal) AS avg_home_goal FROM Match INNER JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT player_name, AVG(finishing) AS avg_finishing
FROM Player 
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) 
   OR Player.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY Player.player_api_id
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) > '1990'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Adam %' AND weight > 170;

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name FROM Player_Attributes JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.overall_rating > 80 AND strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'
SELECT pa.potential FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran' ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT DISTINCT Team.team_long_name FROM Team JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_fifa_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id WHERE Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'

SELECT `Team_Attributes`.`buildUpPlayPassingClass` AS `passing_class` FROM `Team_Attributes` JOIN `Team` ON `Team_Attributes`.`team_api_id` = `Team`.`team_api_id` WHERE `Team`.`team_short_name` = 'CLB' ORDER BY `Team_Attributes`.`date` DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT Team.team_short_name FROM Team JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_fifa_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id WHERE Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND p.height > 170;
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player);
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeed = 31 AND ta.buildUpPlayDribbling = 53 AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing = 32;
SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Aaron Doran'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND Match.date >= '2008-08-01' AND Match.date <= '2008-10-31';
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team T JOIN Match M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id WHERE M.home_team_goal = 10;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.potential = 61 AND pa.balance = (SELECT MAX(pa2.balance) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE pa2.potential = 61)

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END) - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id;
SELECT team_long_name FROM Team WHERE team_short_name = 'GEN';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'
SELECT `Country`.`name` FROM `League` JOIN `Country` ON `League`.`country_id` = `Country`.`id` WHERE `League`.`name` = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Germany';

SELECT Player.player_name AS player_name FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS count FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986' AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone') GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY MAX(pa.crossing) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT heading_accuracy FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS count FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

WITH latest_attrs AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Player_Attributes
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN latest_attrs la ON pa.player_api_id = la.player_api_id AND pa.date = la.max_date
WHERE pa.volleys > 70 AND pa.dribbling > 70;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Match.season = '2008/2009' AND Country.name = 'Belgium'

SELECT pa.long_passing AS long_passing_score
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Player_Attributes
  GROUP BY player_api_id
) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player)
ORDER BY p.player_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN (SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Match WHERE season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY league_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) m ON l.id = m.league_id;
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986';

WITH a AS (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' ORDER BY Player_Attributes.date DESC LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY Player_Attributes.date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (CAST(a.overall_rating AS REAL) - b.overall_rating) * 100.0 / b.overall_rating AS percentage_higher FROM a, b;

SELECT AVG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_build_up_play_speed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
INNER JOIN Team t ON ta.team_fifa_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT SUM(pa.crossing) AS total_crossing_score FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox'

SELECT Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassing, Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Ajax' ORDER BY Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassing DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT pa.preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'

SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT potential FROM Player_Attributes INNER JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00'
SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes pa INNER JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'
SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND pa.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS date FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE pa2.player_api_id = p.player_api_id);

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';
SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes TA JOIN Team T ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';
SELECT ta.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_fifa_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND ta.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'
SELECT t.chanceCreationCrossingClass FROM Team_Attributes t JOIN Team tm ON t.team_api_id = tm.team_api_id WHERE tm.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND t.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'
SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_fifa_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

with d as (
  select overall_rating
  from Player_Attributes join Player on Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
  where player_name = 'Landon Donovan' and date <= '2013-07-12'
  order by date desc limit 1
), b as (
  select overall_rating
  from Player_Attributes join Player on Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
  where player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' and date <= '2013-07-12'
  order by date desc limit 1
)
select (d.overall_rating - b.overall_rating)*100.0 / d.overall_rating as percentage
from d, b;

SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date WHERE p.height > 180 ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 3) AS top_players ORDER BY player_name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT ( (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) ) AS difference;
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes p WHERE p.potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes) AND p.preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY p.player_api_id LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_api_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
  WHERE pa.strength > 80 AND pa.stamina > 80
) e ON p.player_api_id = e.player_api_id;
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa'
SELECT home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin' ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(home_team_goal) AS highest_score FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT l.name AS league_name, COUNT(m.id) AS game_count FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY game_count DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Match m JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE m.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, p.height, pa.overall_rating,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
)
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1 AND height < 180;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) THEN 'more inpatients' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) < COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) THEN 'more outpatients' ELSE 'equal' END AS more, (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0)) AS percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission IN ('+','-')
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN ID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN ID END), 0) AS percentage FROM Patient
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID = 30609
SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID = '163109'
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.LDH > 500;
SELECT DISTINCT e.ID, (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.RVVT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.5) THEN p.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)) AS percentage FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acligg FROM Examination JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.Admission = '+' AND (strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-';
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS min_age FROM Patient p WHERE p.`First Date` IS NOT NULL AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1 AND strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") = '1997' AND p.SEX = 'F';
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.TG >= 200;

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
AND p.Birthday = (
  SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
  FROM Patient p2
  JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID
  WHERE e2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(l.ID) / 12.0 AS average_monthly_tests FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'

WITH oldest AS (SELECT ID, Birthday, `First Date` FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY Birthday ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT MAX(l.Date) AS lab_date, (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_initial FROM Laboratory l JOIN oldest o ON l.ID = o.ID

WITH patient_flags AS (
    SELECT ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) > 0 AND CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_protein,
           MAX(CASE WHEN UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_low_uric
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)

    CASE WHEN SUM(has_normal_protein) = 0 THEN 0 
         ELSE SUM(has_normal_protein * has_low_uric) * 100.0 / SUM(has_normal_protein) 
    END AS percentage
FROM patient_flags;

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_spending FROM member m JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone FROM member m JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);
SELECT (SUM(z.state = 'New Jersey') * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) - (SUM(z.state = 'Vermont') * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS difference FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
SELECT mj.major_name, mj.department FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, e.cost FROM expense e JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies';
SELECT member.last_name, member.phone FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education';
SELECT category, amount FROM budget JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id WHERE event.event_name = 'January Speaker';
SELECT DISTINCT event.event_name FROM event JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event WHERE budget.category = 'Food';
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, i.amount FROM member m JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'
SELECT b.category FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%Posters%'
SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name, college FROM member LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'Secretary';
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts' GROUP BY e.event_name
SELECT z.city FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.position
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.city = 'Lincolnton' AND z.state = 'North Carolina' AND z.zip_code = 28092;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Premium';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio FROM customers

WITH lam_consumption AS ( SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' GROUP BY c.CustomerID ) SELECT CustomerID FROM lam_consumption WHERE total_consumption = (SELECT MIN(total_consumption) FROM lam_consumption);
SELECT AVG(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS avg_monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' AND c.Segment = 'SME';

WITH cust_tot AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201101' AND '201112'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, total_consumption
FROM cust_tot
WHERE total_consumption = (SELECT MAX(total_consumption) FROM cust_tot);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers FROM (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' GROUP BY c.CustomerID HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) < 30000) sub

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

SELECT substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) AS Year, SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS TotalGasUse FROM yearmonth INNER JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY Year ORDER BY TotalGasUse DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.Segment FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.Segment ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(ym.Date,1,4) AS year, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY year ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ym.Date FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY ym.Date ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='SME' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) - (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='LAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) AS diff_SME_LAM, (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='LAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) - (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='KAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) AS diff_LAM_KAM, (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='KAM' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) - (SELECT MIN(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS t FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment='SME' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID) x) AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT c.Segment, (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase, CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) = (SELECT MAX((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM yearmonth ym2 JOIN customers c2 ON c2.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID WHERE c2.Currency = 'EUR' AND c2.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND substr(ym2.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013') GROUP BY c2.Segment) THEN 'highest' ELSE 'lowest' END AS type FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND substr(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013') GROUP BY c.Segment HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) = (SELECT MAX((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM yearmonth ym2 JOIN customers c2 ON c2.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID WHERE c2.Currency = 'EUR' AND c2.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND substr(ym2.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013') GROUP BY c2.Segment) OR (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) = (SELECT MIN((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym2.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM yearmonth ym2 JOIN customers c2 ON c2.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID WHERE c2.Currency = 'EUR' AND c2.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND substr(ym2.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013') GROUP BY c2.Segment);
SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date >= '201308' AND Date <= '201311';

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Discount') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Discount') AS more_discount_gasstations;
SELECT (SELECT Consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 7 AND Date = '201304') - (SELECT Consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 5 AND Date = '201304') AS diff;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID)
SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'EUR' AND ym.Date = '201310' ORDER BY ym.Consumption DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' GROUP BY c.CustomerID ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND ym.Date = '201305';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ym.Consumption),0) FROM yearmonth ym WHERE ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfValueForMoneyStations FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Value for money' GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN CustomerID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)) AS percentage FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS percentage FROM gasstations
SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201309' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.Segment FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE ym.Date = '201309' GROUP BY c.Segment ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date = '201206'
  AND y.Consumption = (
    SELECT MIN(Consumption)
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date = '201206'
      AND CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  );
SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS highest_monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE Date LIKE '2012%';
SELECT MAX(ym.Consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR';

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM products p JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE ym.Date = '201309';

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012' AND strftime('%m', t.Date) = '08';
SELECT DISTINCT gs.ChainID FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN gasstations gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR';
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR';
SELECT AVG(Price) AS avg_price FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date LIKE '2012-01%'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND ym.Consumption > 1000;
SELECT p.Description AS Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT DISTINCT t.Time FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.ChainID = 11;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Price > 1000;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactions_1k JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE gasstations.Country = 'CZE' AND transactions_1k.Date > '2012-01-01'
SELECT AVG(Price) AS avg_total_price FROM transactions_1k JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE gasstations.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT AVG(total_price) AS avg_total_price FROM (SELECT SUM(Price) AS total_price FROM transactions_1k JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY transactions_1k.CustomerID)
SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' ORDER BY t.Time ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.Currency FROM customers c JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT DISTINCT customers.Segment FROM transactions_1k JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-23' AND transactions_1k.Time = '21:20:00';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND t.Date = '2012-08-26' AND t.Time < '13:00:00';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
WHERE c.CustomerID = (SELECT t.CustomerID
                      FROM transactions_1k t
                      ORDER BY t.Date
                      LIMIT 1);
SELECT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '12:42:00'
SELECT ProductID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-23' AND Time = '21:20:00';
SELECT ym.Date, ym.Consumption FROM yearmonth ym WHERE ym.CustomerID = ( SELECT t.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 124.05 LIMIT 1 ) AND ym.Date = '201201';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions_1k JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE gasstations.Country = 'CZE' AND transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-26' AND transactions_1k.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) = 214582.17;
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.CardID = 667467
SELECT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
  LIMIT 1
);
SELECT GasStationID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM transactions_1k GROUP BY GasStationID ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 END AS percentage FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Price), 0) AS total_all_time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-01-31' THEN Price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_jan_2012 FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508
SELECT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t INNER JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.CustomerID, 1.0 * SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2 AND t.Amount = 1
AND t.Price = (SELECT MAX(Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = 2 AND Amount = 1);

SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID, ym.Consumption FROM customers c JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID LEFT JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID AND ym.Date = '201208' WHERE t.ProductID = 5 AND t.Price / t.Amount > 29.0;
